verdict.rationale: Brex publishes per-domain API reference pages (transactions, budgets, expenses, payments, webhooks, onboarding). It also maintains an official Postman developer workspace with collections for all Brex APIs, which gives users first-party runnable requests. Nothing shows the reference itself is interactive (e.g., an in-browser try-it console), and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at standard paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-page interactive try-it console, runnable code samples embedded in the reference, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
